system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: A wide, near-black frame holds in stillness. <Subject:car> is a dark mass at the far edge of visibility, its low-slung body and matte paint almost merged with the surrounding blackness. Wet asphalt stretches around it in a bare concrete loading bay, and a thin haze catches a pale overhead spill light, leaving only faint edge highlights on the hood and roof. The car sits motionless, unlit headlights facing forward, while the darkness presses close on every side. The space feels empty and cold, with puddle reflections barely separating the ground from the shadow. The car's presence is established before any movement, a quiet weight waiting at the threshold.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: A wide, near-black view holds still; <Subject:car> is barely separable from the surrounding darkness, with only faint edge highlights marking its hood and roofline.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low engine rumble idles under the darkness, steady and close.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: A pale spill light catches a thin haze and a faint sheen on the wet asphalt, leaving <Subject:car> still mostly swallowed by shadow.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The <Subject:car> eases forward out of the dark, its mass becoming more legible as the low-slung silhouette separates from the black. Wet asphalt glistens ahead; faint spill light slides across the matte paint and unlit headlights while thin haze drifts past the body. The car advances at a deliberate pace, tires rolling with a faint scuff, and the low engine rumble deepens into a steadier presence. The surrounding loading bay remains bare and shadowed, but the vehicle now occupies the center of attention, its forward motion pulling detail out of the darkness. The engine note grows more present without becoming harsh, and the car's weight shifts visibly as it closes the distance.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: The <Subject:car> pulls forward, its mass easing out of the dark toward the foreground.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The engine rumble deepens as the car begins to roll.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: Faint reflections slide across the wet concrete in front of the <Subject:car> as its hood and windshield catch a thin edge of light.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: The <Subject:car> advances at a steady pace, its silhouette growing clearer against the surrounding blackness.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:4: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.shot:shot-3:description: The <Subject:car> continues its forward roll, holding the frame as more of its dark body emerges into the faint overhead spill. The matte paint and unlit headlights remain subdued, while wet reflections streak the concrete beneath it and thin haze curls around the tires. The car's advance is steady and deliberate, the low engine rumble settling into a sustained pulse that seems to fill the surrounding blackness. Darkness presses close along the flanks and rear, but the front of the vehicle stays readable, its mass rolling onward with quiet persistence. The final beat keeps the movement alive, the car still pushing forward as the shadows close around it.
